title: Check JSON text
summary: MariaDB can work with JSON text using JSON functions.
introduction: MariaDB can work with JSON text using JSON functions. Your task: Read another field from a small JSON object.
learningObjectives: Read another field from a small JSON object.
Explain the example for check json text

blocks.text: MariaDB can work with JSON text using JSON functions. JSON_VALID checks its shape, and JSON_EXTRACT reads a value.

Use MariaDB 10.11+ with its mariadb client in an empty practice database. These dialect-specific examples do not run in the site's SQLite playground. Keep the sample database separate from real records.

blocks.code: SELECT JSON_VALID('{"title":"Moon Trip"}') AS valid_json,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT('{"title":"Moon Trip"}','$.title')) AS title;
blocks.title: Check JSON text

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `JSON_EXTRACT` follows the JSON path to a field. JSON_UNQUOTE removes JSON string quotes from the result.
`SELECT` names the output values. `AS` can give a calculated result a readable column name.

blocks.text: valid_json is 1 and title is Moon Trip.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not assume MariaDB JSON storage is identical to another database's binary JSON type. Learn the engine's rules.
